title: OCTFlow: Unified conditional generation for balanced classification and annotated segmentation in retinal OCT

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《OCTFlow: Unified conditional generation for balanced classification and annotated segmentation in retinal OCT》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】The scarcity of annotated medical images, compounded by severe class imbalance and labor-intensive pixel-wise annotation, fundamentally constrains the development of robust diagnostic systems in retinal OCT analysis.

evidence.text: The scarcity of annotated medical images, compounded by severe class imbalance and labor-intensive pixel-wise annotation, fundamentally constrains the development of robust diagnostic systems in retinal OCT analysis.
